svg.title: Customers: the companies and contacts a ticket is for — SoftTrack web design mockup (#290)
svg.desc: “Acme cannot download their invoices” has the customer in the title and nowhere else. A company has a name, its email domains and notes, a contact has a name and an address, both belong to the instance, a ticket can name both, and a company’s page shows its open tickets across the teams the viewer is on.
